hooks.description: Auto-format PHP files with Pint after edits
Run PHPStan on app file changes to catch type errors early
Run specific test file after editing it

hooks.command: echo 'Blocked: Removing vendor directory requires manual confirmation' >&2 && exit 2
echo 'Blocked: Force push requires manual confirmation' >&2 && exit 2
hooks.description: Block force pushes to prevent accidental history rewrites

hooks.command: echo 'Blocked: Hard reset requires manual confirmation' >&2 && exit 2
hooks.description: Block hard resets to prevent accidental work loss

hooks.command:
cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && echo '## Quality Guardrails Active

This project enforces code quality through:
- **Pint**: Code formatting (PER standard + strict types)
- **Larastan**: Static analysis at level 9
- **PHPMD**: Complexity checks (CC≤5, methods≤30 lines)
- **Pest**: Testing with architecture rules

Run `composer quality` to execute all checks.

CI runs on every push via GitHub Actions.'
hooks.description: Remind about quality guardrails on session start
